Question: Alan, Beth, Carlos, and Diana were discussing their possible grades in mathematics class this grading period. Alan said, “If I get an A, then Beth will get an A.” Beth said, “If I get an A, then Carlos will get an A.” Carlos said, “If I get an A, then Diana will get an A.” All of these statements were true, but only two of the students received an A. Which two received A’s?
